label.zh-TW: App Store：Timberland 官方商城（開發者網站為 timberland.com.tw）
label.en: App Store: Timberland app (developer website on timberland.com.tw)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (a bmai.app short link; there is no code).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 Timberland 官方商城 App，請只從 App Store 或 Google Play 的官方上架頁安裝。
steps.en: Follow the page to download the Timberland app, and install it only from its official App Store or Google Play listing.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 後依指示註冊或登入會員。
steps.en: Open the app and register or log in as the app directs.

intro.zh-TW: Timberland 官方商城 App 的分享連結；分享文案沒有提到邀請碼或優惠。
intro.en: Share link for the Timberland Taiwan app; the share text mentions no code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
Timberland 官方商城是 Timberland 台灣官方網站的 App，可免費下載；App Store 上架頁的開發者網站是 timberland.com.tw。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼，是否綁定邀請人未查證。分享文案只寫「推薦你下載 Timberland App」，沒有提到優惠，不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
Timberland 官方商城 is the shopping app of the official Timberland Taiwan website, and it is free to download. The App Store listing names timberland.com.tw as the developer website.

The link on this page is the bmai.app short link from the share text and it carries no invite code; whether it is tied to a referrer was not checked. The share text only recommends downloading the app and mentions no offer, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有邀請碼，也沒有優惠，連結原樣保留。bmai.app 是共用的第三方 App 連結服務，只因網站規則要求連結主機必須列入官方網域才列入；請不要把其他 bmai.app 網址當成 Timberland 官方連結。2026-10-24 以桌面瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 timberland.com.tw 首頁；手機上的轉址，以及連結是否記錄邀請關係，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en: The share text has no invite code and no offer, and the link is kept exactly as shared. bmai.app is a shared third-party app-link service, listed only because the site's rules require the link host to be in the official domains; do not treat other bmai.app links as Timberland official links. Opened in a desktop browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to the timberland.com.tw home page; the mobile redirect and whether the link records a referral were not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: Timberland 的分享連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the Timberland share link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有邀請碼可提供：分享文案沒有邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟；App 註冊時是否有邀請碼欄位沒有查證。
a.en: This site has no invite code to give: the share text has none, so open the link on this page. Whether the app's sign-up has a code field was not checked.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結下載 App 有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for downloading the app through this link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有列出優惠。分享文案只提到下載；Timberland 官網有提到會員好友的說明，內容本站沒有讀到，與這條連結是否有關沒有查證。
a.en: No offer is listed here. The share text only mentions downloading; Timberland’s site mentions a member friend programme, whose details this site did not read, and whether it relates to this link was not checked.
